name: anti-slop
description: Detects and removes LLM slop from business and narrative prose in English and German. 1843 entries (1836 distinct terms) across three grep-checked lists — 1190 English, 496 German, 157 language-neutral (stock names and places, chatbot artifacts, unfilled placeholders) — every term carrying a hard/soft severity, plus a flexion-aware checker so German inflected forms are actually found. Lists are never loaded into context.
